subject.note: Cohort description from the challenge; no inferred subject-specific age or sex.

source.name: Cardiac Atlas Project / STACOM 2011 cMAC

pairing.label: Same volunteer · separate acquisitions
pairing.note: Whole-heart MRI and ultrasound are not co-registered here. Cine slots are separate measured phases, not simultaneous MRI/ultrasound observations.

documentedReferenceFrames.source: Official readme.pdf, final-frame/end-systolic table, v1 column

format.order: X fastest, then Y, then Z
format.sourceTransforms: MRI: per-slice DICOM rescale followed by a fixed linear display window and 8-bit rounding. Ultrasound: exact source VTK uint8 samples.

series.label: Whole-heart MRI · cardiac region

crop.description: Conservative rectangular field of view around the heart and proximal vessels; includes adjacent tissues, not an anatomical segmentation. All original left-right slices are retained.

sourceHeader.intensityUnits: arbitrary MR signal after per-image DICOM rescale

series.samplingDescription: 0.75 × 0.75 × 1.5 mm stored grid; 3 mm source slice thickness
series.phaseDescription: One whole-heart SSFP volume; source protocol gated at end-diastole and end-expiration. DICOM trigger time 740 ms.
notes: A conservative rectangular cardiac field of view preserves the native grid; adjacent tissues remain and intensity surfaces are not anatomical segmentation.
The 1.5 mm slice interval is overlapping reconstruction spacing, not proof of 1.5 mm acquired through-plane resolution.
The whole-heart MRI has a different DICOM frame of reference from the cine/tagged MRI.

series.label: 4D apical ultrasound
series.coordinateSystem: Source VTK ultrasound-local coordinates; not DICOM LPS
series.phaseDescription: Recorded 4D apical ultrasound, 47.2885 ms per volume. Separate acquisition from MRI.
notes: All source VTK ultrasound intensities are retained exactly, with lossless gzip compression.
Grid spacing is not the ultrasound system’s spatial resolving power.
The volume contains an apical acoustic sector, not complete whole-heart coverage.

series.label: Cine short-axis MRI

sourceHeader.intensityUnits: arbitrary MR signal after per-image DICOM rescale

series.samplingDescription: 1.25 × 1.25 × 8 mm stored grid; 30 measured phase slots
series.phaseDescription: Each phase slot combines 14 separately acquired SAX slices. Trigger times vary by slice; displayed time is their median, not a simultaneous 3D timestamp.
notes: Preserves the native 8 mm slice separation. Interpolated display does not create fine through-plane anatomy.
All phases share one fixed display encoding window of 0–2600 arbitrary rescaled MR units.
This cine MRI and the ultrasound were acquired separately and are not synchronized in the viewer.
